testcase.name: EffectScene.of: nonnull domain, limits and layers; lifetime > 0 (finite or UNBOUNDED); unique layer names; layer and point counts within the limits; empty scenes allowed; the list is copied and unmodifiable
Shape: finite nonnull points, at most 2^20; 0 points allowed; the input list is copied
EffectScene.evaluate: null anchor, playback or instant gives IllegalArgumentException
Motion: spin axis finite with largest component >= 1e-12, |turns| <= 2^20, finite phase; scales in [1e-9, 1e9]; finite translations; nonnull drives and easings; at most 16 steps
StyleKey: namespace [a-z0-9_.-]{1,32}, one colon, path [a-z0-9_./-]{1,64}; anything else (null, empty parts, upper case, spaces, two colons, slash in the namespace, overlong parts) is rejected
